title: 4 Nurses Needed (2 Enrolled & 2 RN)
qualification: Certificate in Nursing/Midwifery (Enrolled) or Diploma in Nursing/Midwifery (RN); valid practicing license
description:
**WE ARE HIRING!**

**Compassionate Care Network Uganda** is recruiting **4 Nurses (2 Enrolled Nurses & 2 Registered Nurses/RN)** to join our dedicated healthcare team.

*Your health, our heartbeat.*

---

### Open Positions

**1. Enrolled Nurses (2 positions)**

**Requirements:**
- A **Certificate in Nursing/Midwifery**
- **Valid practicing license** from the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC)
- At least **2 years of experience** in a clinical setting
- **Fluent in both Gishu (local language) and English**
- Able to exhibit a **high degree of professionalism**

**2. Registered Nurses / RN (2 positions)**

**Requirements:**
- A **Diploma in Nursing/Midwifery**
- **Valid practicing license** from the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC)
- At least **1 year of experience** in a clinical setting
- Able to exhibit a **high degree of professionalism**

---

### About Compassionate Care Network Uganda

Compassionate Care Network Uganda (CCNU) is a healthcare organisation committed to delivering compassionate, quality and patient-centred care to communities across Uganda. Our motto, *"Your health, our heartbeat,"* reflects our commitment to treating every patient with dignity, empathy and clinical excellence.

### Key Responsibilities (all roles)
- Provide direct nursing care to patients in accordance with CCNU protocols and Uganda Ministry of Health guidelines
- Administer medications, monitor vital signs and document patient observations accurately
- Assist with admissions, discharges and patient/family education
- Maintain infection prevention and control standards at all times
- Collaborate with doctors, clinical officers and other members of the multidisciplinary team
- Respond to emergencies and participate in continuous quality improvement activities

### How to Apply

Submit your **CV** to: **compassionatecarenu@gmail.com**

**Deadline: 10th September 2026 at 5:00 PM (EAT).** Late applications will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews.
